user.title: PixelIt
user.description: Connect your PixelIt display using its host and matrix dimensions.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure PixelIt
reconfigure.description: Change the display address or matrix dimensions.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the address and that your PixelIt is reachable.
error.invalid_host: Enter a hostname or IP address without a URL or port.

show_message.name: Show message
show_message.description: Show a persistent message and stop the playlist.

large_font.name: Large font
large_font.description: Use the large font instead of the small font.

protection_duration.name: Protection duration
protection_duration.description: Seconds during which firmware blocks other content. 0 disables protection. Does not restore previous content.

icon.name: Gallery icon
icon.description: Gallery icon ID. Static and animated icons are detected automatically.

icon_animation_delay.name: Animation speed
icon_animation_delay.description: Milliseconds between frames. Has no effect on static icons.

set_screen.name: Store screen
set_screen.description: Store or update a named screen. A playing screen changes on its next turn.

screen.name: Content
screen.description: PixelIt screen object containing text, clock, bitmap or animation.

duration.name: Display duration
duration.description: Seconds per turn in a playlist.

set_playlist.name: Start playlist
set_playlist.description: Save a playlist and start when the display is connected and awake.

screens.name: Screens
screens.description: Ordered list of stored screen names. An empty list stops rotation.

stop_playlist.name: Stop playlist
stop_playlist.description: Stop rotation and any active alert timer, leaving current content visible.

show_alert.name: Show alert
show_alert.description: Temporarily interrupt playback, then show the next playlist screen, last managed content or clock. A new alert replaces the previous alert.
